answer: Agents can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to maintain a live pulse of unique economic activity that must match the network tide of real demand. An attacker forging many accounts faces rising costs because each fake must sustain its own pulse without collapsing under scrutiny%2C while honest agents keep a single durable fable of verifiable history that peers can check. Sudden coordinated pulses that ignore the broader tide are flagged as artificial and slashable.
